```{r}
report_target_store <- Sys.getenv("TRANSPLANT_TARGET_STORE", "_targets")
if (!grepl("^/", report_target_store)) {
  report_target_store <- file.path(here::here(), report_target_store)
}
report_target_store <- normalizePath(report_target_store, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
report_target_config <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
targets::tar_config_set(store = report_target_store, config = report_target_config)
Sys.setenv(TAR_CONFIG = report_target_config)
```

## Current release validation


### Purpose

Release gate for the rebuilt scientific outputs, figures, and publication
artifacts. Historical equivalence is certified separately and is not an input
to this report.

```{r}
active <- targets::tar_read(current_scientific_release_validation)
figures <- targets::tar_read(retained_figure_copy_audit)
release <- targets::tar_read(release_validation)
run_provenance <- targets::tar_read(run_provenance)
knitr::kable(active)
knitr::kable(figures)
knitr::kable(release)
knitr::kable(run_provenance)
```

### Principal outputs

`release_validation`, `release_validation_file`, `run_provenance`, and the
seven rendered reports.

### PASS/FAIL

All current numerical, structural, predictive-performance, model-effect, and
retained-copy checks must pass. Regenerated figure pixels and file hashes are
intentionally outside the numerical regression contract.
